resources.string:
1. One-time setup: build the reader firmware with SERIAL_MONITOR enabled in Cart_Reader/Config.h (comment out the HW# line, uncomment //#define SERIAL_MONITOR) and flash it. This moves the reader's menu from the OLED/LCD to the USB serial port.

2. Insert a cartridge into the reader, plug the reader into this device with a USB OTG cable and tap Connect. The reader resets and prints its main menu.

3. Menu options appear as buttons above the text box — tap one to select it (or type its number and tap Send). Use the ▲/▼ page buttons for long menus.

4. Pick your console, then choose Read ROM (or Read Save). The dump is written to the SD card in the reader; progress and checksums are shown here.

5. Optional: tap Capture before starting to also record everything the reader prints into Downloads/CartReader on this device.

6. When the dump finishes, the ROM file is on the reader's SD card in a folder named after the game. Pop the SD card into this device with a card reader (or into a PC) to copy the file.

Tip: the reader expects single characters — the app sends exactly what you tap or type, with no newline added.
